title: Western Alliance Bank Leaders Named to the Los Angeles Business Journal’s 2026 Top 100 Bankers List
summary: Five Western Alliance Bank leaders have been named among the 2026 Top 100 Bankers by the Los Angeles Business Journal. The honorees represent five of Western Alliance’s specialized banking groups.
body_markdown:
Five Western Alliance Bank leaders have been named among the 2026 Top 100 Bankers by the Los Angeles Business Journal. The honorees represent five of Western Alliance’s specialized banking groups: Affordable Housing, Asset-Based Lending, Entertainment & Media, Food, Agriculture & Beverage and Private Client Group.


The honorees reflect Western Alliance’s approach of pairing specialized expertise in more than 30 industries with dedicated bankers who understand their clients’ businesses, delivering personalized solutions to support their growth.


“Each of these bankers has built deep knowledge of the industry they serve, which strengthens the trust clients place in them to find the right financing for growing their businesses,” said Tim Bruckner, Chief Banking Officer, Regional Banking, Western Alliance Bank. “Together, they reflect how Western Alliance pairs the capabilities of a national commercial bank with the direct access and personal relationships our clients depend on in Los Angeles and nationwide.”


Western Alliance’s 2026 honorees:


- Mieke Holkeboer, director of[Affordable Housing Finance](https://www.westernalliancebancorporation.com/commercial-corporate/affordable-housing-investments) , leads the group which operates in more than 25 states. Since joining the bank in 2020, Holkeboer and her team have helped finance the construction and rehabilitation of more than 7,400 affordable homes. Her team structures construction and construction-to-permanent financing for developers, using structures that give borrowers added flexibility as projects move toward completion.
- Dean Indot, director of the[Private Client Group](https://www.westernalliancebancorporation.com/personal/private-client) , launched the Beverly Hills-based group in 2025 to serve registered investment advisors (RIAs), family offices and their high-net-worth clients. The Private Client Group complements the investment guidance those advisors already deliver, providing expertise in practice finance and customized solutions for liquidity, treasury management and mortgages. Indot, who joined Western Alliance in 2013, built the group to pair the resources of a national bank with the responsiveness of a boutique institution.
- Victor Le, head of the[Asset-Based Lending Group](https://www.westernalliancebancorporation.com/commercial/asset-based-lending) , leads a team of bankers and analysts who provide financing backed by receivables, inventory, equipment and other balance sheet assets. Over the past decade, Le has risen from relationship manager to lead the group, which works closely with Western Alliance’s industry specialty teams in sectors including aerospace and defense, innovation banking, healthcare and food and beverage. Many of the group’s clients are growing companies that use asset-based lending to fund expansion or strengthen working capital.
- Leo Muñoz, industry executive for the[Food, Agriculture & Beverage Group](https://www.westernalliancebancorporation.com/expertise/food-agriculture-beverage) , brings 28 years of banking experience to growers, processors and food and beverage companies. He joined Western Alliance in 2024 to build this practice from the ground up. The group offers customized credit structures and covenant packages designed around production cycles and how each business operates, with a team that is nimble enough to move quickly and large enough to provide meaningful financing.
- Jonathan Osborn, senior vice president of the[Entertainment & Media Group](https://www.westernalliancebancorporation.com/expertise/entertainment-media) , brings nearly 15 years of banking experience, deep expertise in music industry finance and an emphasis on authenticity in client relationships. He leads a Los Angeles-based team that helps entertainment clients navigate complex, rapidly changing financing needs across film and television production, streaming and digital media, and music publishing.


View the[full list](https://labusinessjournal.com/events/topbankers26/) of the Los Angeles Business Journal’s Top 100 Bankers for 2026.
